paragraphs.en: Long-horizon agents must coordinate reasoning, tool use, and environment feedback over extended interactions. Learning from sparse outcome rewards requires weighting trajectories of different lengths and updating the policy while rollouts are still being collected. We examine a single-rollout asynchronous recipe combining Muon, token-averaged loss, truncated importance sampling, and auxiliary length and tool-error penalties. Single-rollout sampling allows asynchronous learning without waiting for multiple trajectories for the same issue. We study optimizer choices and recipe components for repository-level issue resolution across two model families. The evaluated training runs show higher training success with the full recipe than with the baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 长期规划的智能体必须在持续交互中协调推理、工具使用和环境反馈。 从稀疏的结果奖励中学习，需要为不同长度的轨迹分配权重，并在收集 rollout 数据的同时更新策略。 我们研究了一种单 roll-out 异步方案，结合了 Muon、令牌平均损失、截断重要性采样以及辅助的长度和工具错误惩罚项。 单 roll-out 采样使得异步学习成为可能，无需等待同一问题的多个轨迹。 我们研究了优化器选择及该方案各组件在两个模型家族中解决仓库级问题的能力。 评估的训练运行结果表明，完整方案比基线方法具有更高的训练成功率。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level issue resolution requires an agent to interpret an issue description, navigate and edit the codebase, and validate a candidate patch ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Such workflows require coordinated execution across dependent steps, a defining feature of long-horizon agents ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . Executable tests make these interactions a source of reinforcement-learning feedback ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ) . Trajectory lengths vary, and asynchronous collection introduces a gap between rollout and learner policies. We study how optimizer choice affects learning from sparse outcomes under these conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库级别的故障解决需要智能体解读故障描述、浏览和编辑代码库，并验证候选补丁（Jimenez 等，2023；Yang 等，2024）。 此类工作流程需要在依赖的各个步骤中协同执行，这是长期规划智能体的典型特征（Wu 等，2026a）。 可执行的测试使这些交互成为强化学习反馈的来源（Jain 等，2025；Luo 等，2025；Song 等，2026）。 轨迹长度各不相同，而异步收集会在执行策略与学习策略之间产生延迟。 我们研究了在这些条件下，优化器的选择如何影响从稀疏结果中学习的效果。

paragraphs.en: We compare Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) and Muon ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) within Single-stream Policy Optimization (SPO) ( Xu and Ding, 2025 ) , then study how Muon combines with SPO++ ( Ruan et al., 2026b ) , reward shaping, and importance correction. Ablations examine the length penalty ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , tool-error penalty, and update rules using the same training success rate metric.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单流策略优化（SPO）（Xu 和 Ding，2025）的框架下比较了 Adam（Kingma 和 Ba，2014）与 Muon（Jordan 等人，2024），接着研究了 Muon 如何与 SPO++（Ruan 等人，2026b）、奖励塑造以及重要性校正相结合。 消融实验通过相同的训练成功率指标，检验了长度惩罚（Yu 等人，2025）、工具错误惩罚以及更新规则。

paragraphs.en: The full recipe achieves higher training success than the SPO baselines in the selected runs from both model families (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在所有选定的运行中，完整配方在两个模型家族中都比 SPO 基线方法取得了更高的训练成功率（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering (SWE) agents interact with code repositories and use execution-based evaluation ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , supported by environments and training tasks such as SWE-Gym, R2E-Gym, and SWE-smith ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; JLULLM LAB, 2026 ) . Training feedback can come from software evolution ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , test execution ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ) , or simulation ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Our experiments use execution-based rewards to study policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程（SWE）智能体与代码仓库进行交互，并使用基于执行的评估方法（Jimenez 等，2023；Yang 等，2024；Wang 等，2024），其运行由 SWE-Gym、R2E-Gym 和 SWE-smith 等环境与训练任务提供支持（Pan 等，2024；Jain 等，2025；Yang 等，2025；JLULLM LAB，2026）。 训练反馈可以来自软件演化（Wei 等，2025）、测试执行（Luo 等，2025；Song 等，2026）或模拟（Sun 等，2026）。 我们的实验使用基于执行的奖励来研究策略优化。

paragraphs.en: SPO and SPO++ provide the single-rollout foundation of our recipe ( Xu and Ding, 2025 ; Ruan et al., 2026b ) . SAO uses value-model learning and token-level masking based on importance ratios ( Hou et al., 2026 ) , whereas FlashReinforce combines critic-free updates with token importance sampling and a sequence-level trust region ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . Other methods address off-policy agent training through turn-level correction ( Li et al., 2025 ) and variance control ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Muon has also been studied in mathematical and interactive RL ( Fan et al., 2026 ; Ruan et al., 2026a ) . We study Muon within single-rollout asynchronous training for issue resolution.
paragraphs.zh: SPO 和 SPO++ 为我们提出的方法提供了单次展开的基础（Xu 和 Ding，2025；Ruan 等，2026b）。 SAO 采用价值模型学习和基于重要性比率的词元级掩码（Hou 等，2026），而 FlashReinforce 则将无评论家更新与词元重要性采样及序列级信任区域相结合（Hu 等，2026）。 其他方法通过回合级修正（Li 等，2025）和方差控制（Huang 等，2026）来解决离策略智能体训练问题。 Muon 也已在数学和交互式强化学习领域得到研究（Fan 等，2026；Ruan 等，2026a）。 我们研究了 Muon 在解决任务问题时的单次展开异步训练方法。

paragraphs.en: Reward shaping determines how task outcomes and intermediate behavior contribute to learning, while loss aggregation determines the weight of trajectories with different lengths. Both are studied in agentic RL recipes ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Masud et al., 2026 ) and in reasoning RL through length penalties and trajectory weighting ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) . We examine their combination with Muon in multi-turn software repair.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励塑造决定了任务结果和中间行为如何促进学习，而损失聚合则决定了不同长度轨迹的权重。 这两者在智能体强化学习的方法中（Wang 等，2026；Wu 等，2026b；Masud 等，2026）以及在通过长度惩罚和轨迹加权进行推理的强化学习中（Yu 等，2025；Zeng 等，2026）均有研究。 我们在多轮软件修复中利用 Muon 检验了它们的组合效果。

paragraphs.en: For each sampled issue, the agent produces one rollout by interacting with the repository through tools. Rollout collection proceeds asynchronously with policy updates, introducing policy lag.

paragraphs.en: Newton–Schulz iterations compute this approximation using matrix multiplications, avoiding an explicit SVD ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) . Our implementation applies it to hidden weight matrices; embeddings, the output head, normalization parameters, and vector parameters use AdamW.
paragraphs.zh: 牛顿-舒尔茨迭代通过矩阵乘法计算这一近似值，从而避免了显式的奇异值分解（Jordan 等，2024）。 我们的实现将其应用于隐藏层权重矩阵；嵌入层、输出头、归一化参数和向量参数则使用 AdamW。

paragraphs.en: The SPO baseline computes advantages from outcome rewards and its task-specific baseline, then standardizes them across trajectories and uses proximal policy optimization (PPO)-style clipping ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Xu and Ding, 2025 ) . We define valid tokens as agent-generated tokens included in the policy loss. Our recipe follows SPO++ in standardizing advantages across valid tokens ( Ruan et al., 2026b ) , with auxiliary reward shaping for issue resolution (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: SPO基线方法从结果奖励及其任务特定基线中计算优势值，然后对这些值进行跨轨迹标准化，并使用近端策略优化（PPO）风格的裁剪（Schulman等，2017；Xu和Ding，2025）。 我们将有效令牌定义为智能体生成的、包含在策略损失中的令牌。 我们的方法遵循SPO++的做法，对有效令牌的优势值进行标准化（Ruan等，2026b），并通过辅助奖励塑造来解决相关问题（图1）。

sents.en: The SPO baseline computes advantages from outcome rewards and its task-specific baseline, then standardizes them across trajectories and uses proximal policy optimization (PPO)-style clipping ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Xu and Ding, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: SPO基线方法从结果奖励及其任务特定基线中计算优势值，然后对这些值进行跨轨迹标准化，并使用近端策略优化（PPO）风格的裁剪（Schulman等，2017；Xu和Ding，2025）。

sents.en: We define valid tokens as agent-generated tokens included in the policy loss.
sents.zh: 我们将有效令牌定义为智能体生成的、包含在策略损失中的令牌。

sents.en: Our recipe follows SPO++ in standardizing advantages across valid tokens ( Ruan et al., 2026b ) , with auxiliary reward shaping for issue resolution (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 我们的方法遵循SPO++的做法，对有效令牌的优势值进行标准化（Ruan等，2026b），并通过辅助奖励塑造来解决相关问题（图1）。

paragraphs.en: Following DAPO’s Clip-Higher settings ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , the PPO importance-sampling ratio uses asymmetric clipping with ϵ low = 0.2 \epsilon_{\mathrm{low}}=0.2 and ϵ high = 0.28 \epsilon_{\mathrm{high}}=0.28 .
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 DAPO 的 Clip-Higher 设置（Yu et al., 2025），PPO 重要性采样比率采用非对称裁剪，其中 ϵ low = 0.2 \epsilon_{\mathrm{low}}=0.2 且 ϵ high = 0.28 \epsilon_{\mathrm{high}}=0.28。

paragraphs.en: Following SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) , the final patch receives a binary outcome reward of 1 if it passes all fail-to-pass (F2P) and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests, and 0 otherwise. F2P tests check issue resolution; P2P tests check for regressions. Empty test sets and evaluations interrupted by infrastructure failures remain unscored.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2023 年）的做法，如果最终补丁通过所有“失败转成功”（F2P）和“成功转成功”（P2P）测试，则获得 1 的二元结果奖励；否则为 0。 F2P 测试用于检查问题是否得到解决；P2P 测试则用于检测回归问题。 空的测试集以及因基础设施故障而中断的评估将不计分。

sents.en: Following SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) , the final patch receives a binary outcome reward of 1 if it passes all fail-to-pass (F2P) and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests, and 0 otherwise.

sents.en: F2P tests check issue resolution; P2P tests check for regressions.
sents.zh: F2P 测试用于检查问题是否得到解决；P2P 测试则用于检测回归问题。

sents.en: Empty test sets and evaluations interrupted by infrastructure failures remain unscored.
sents.zh: 空的测试集以及因基础设施故障而中断的评估将不计分。

paragraphs.en: The length penalty discourages long agent responses at each interaction turn. The tool-error penalty applies to invalid actions and designated tool, command, session, or execution errors reported in observations.

paragraphs.en: The main recipe uses token-level averaging, which weights each trajectory mean in proportion to T i T_{i} . The sequence-level averaging ablation weights trajectory means equally and keeps advantage standardization unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 主要配方使用了词元级平均法，该方法按照 T_i（T_{i}）的比例为每条轨迹均值分配权重。 序列级平均法的消融研究则对轨迹均值赋予相等的权重，并保持优势标准化不变。

paragraphs.en: Training uses issue-resolution tasks from R2E-Gym ( Jain et al., 2025 ) . The agent interacts with the execution environment through the Claude Code harness (version 2.1.118). Training success rate is the fraction of evaluated rollouts whose final patches pass all required tests in each update; auxiliary penalties are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 训练使用了来自 R2E-Gym（Jain 等人，2025）的问题解决任务。 智能体通过 Claude Code 工具包（版本 2.1.118）与执行环境进行交互。 训练成功率是指每次更新中，经过评估的运行实例其最终补丁通过所有必要测试的比例；辅助惩罚项不计入其中。

sents.en: Training uses issue-resolution tasks from R2E-Gym ( Jain et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 训练使用了来自 R2E-Gym（Jain 等人，2025）的问题解决任务。

sents.en: The agent interacts with the execution environment through the Claude Code harness (version 2.1.118).
sents.zh: 智能体通过 Claude Code 工具包（版本 2.1.118）与执行环境进行交互。

sents.en: Training success rate is the fraction of evaluated rollouts whose final patches pass all required tests in each update; auxiliary penalties are excluded.
sents.zh: 训练成功率是指每次更新中，经过评估的运行实例其最终补丁通过所有必要测试的比例；辅助惩罚项不计入其中。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MiniCPM5-2B ( OpenBMB, 2026 ) and Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) with the same training-update and rollout budgets across independently initialized runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在独立初始化的运行中，使用相同的训练更新和发布预算来评估 MiniCPM5-2B（OpenBMB，2026）和 Qwen3.5-4B（Qwen Team，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Curves show the longest available training run per configuration, with a separately selected run for MiniCPM5-2B with SPO + Muon (Figure 3 ). Figure 2 summarizes the same runs using mean success over updates 90–100 when that window is complete, and the last observed value otherwise. Numerical summaries use recorded values; matched comparisons use complete windows from runs with the same seed.
paragraphs.zh: 曲线展示了每种配置下可用的最长训练运行时间，其中 MiniCPM5-2B 搭配 SPO + Muon 的配置单独选用了特定运行（图 3）。 图 2 总结了相同的运行结果：当更新窗口 90–100 完成时，使用该窗口的平均成功率；否则，则使用最后观测到的值。 数值摘要使用记录的值；匹配比较则使用具有相同种子值的运行中完整的窗口数据。

sents.en: Curves show the longest available training run per configuration, with a separately selected run for MiniCPM5-2B with SPO + Muon (Figure 3 ).
sents.zh: 曲线展示了每种配置下可用的最长训练运行时间，其中 MiniCPM5-2B 搭配 SPO + Muon 的配置单独选用了特定运行（图 3）。

sents.en: Figure 2 summarizes the same runs using mean success over updates 90–100 when that window is complete, and the last observed value otherwise.
sents.zh: 图 2 总结了相同的运行结果：当更新窗口 90–100 完成时，使用该窗口的平均成功率；否则，则使用最后观测到的值。

sents.en: Numerical summaries use recorded values; matched comparisons use complete windows from runs with the same seed.
sents.zh: 数值摘要使用记录的值；匹配比较则使用具有相同种子值的运行中完整的窗口数据。

paragraphs.en: Adam and Muon share the SPO baseline’s data, rollout budgets, termination rules, and loss aggregation. Both collect task-specific outcome statistics online, without SPO’s offline initialization.
paragraphs.zh: Adam 和 Muon 共享 SPO 基线模型的数据、展开预算、终止规则和损失聚合方式。 两者都在线收集任务特定的结果统计数据，而无需 SPO 的离线初始化。

sents.en: Adam and Muon share the SPO baseline’s data, rollout budgets, termination rules, and loss aggregation.
sents.zh: Adam 和 Muon 共享 SPO 基线模型的数据、展开预算、终止规则和损失聚合方式。

sents.en: Both collect task-specific outcome statistics online, without SPO’s offline initialization.
sents.zh: 两者都在线收集任务特定的结果统计数据，而无需 SPO 的离线初始化。

paragraphs.en: The full-recipe comparison holds Muon fixed while jointly changing advantage normalization, task-specific outcome estimation, clipping, and auxiliary penalties. Component ablations remove either or both penalties, or vary TIS and loss aggregation with the length penalty disabled. Each configuration collects its own trajectories through asynchronous rollouts; comparisons pair runs with the same seed.
paragraphs.zh: 完整配方对比在固定 Muon 的同时，联合调整优势归一化、任务特定的结果估计、截断以及辅助惩罚项。 组件消融实验会移除其中一个或两个惩罚项，或在禁用长度惩罚项的情况下调整 TIS 和损失聚合方式。 每种配置都通过异步展开收集其自身的轨迹；对比时会将使用相同种子的运行进行配对。

sents.en: The full-recipe comparison holds Muon fixed while jointly changing advantage normalization, task-specific outcome estimation, clipping, and auxiliary penalties.
sents.zh: 完整配方对比在固定 Muon 的同时，联合调整优势归一化、任务特定的结果估计、截断以及辅助惩罚项。

sents.en: Component ablations remove either or both penalties, or vary TIS and loss aggregation with the length penalty disabled.
sents.zh: 组件消融实验会移除其中一个或两个惩罚项，或在禁用长度惩罚项的情况下调整 TIS 和损失聚合方式。

sents.en: Each configuration collects its own trajectories through asynchronous rollouts; comparisons pair runs with the same seed.
sents.zh: 每种配置都通过异步展开收集其自身的轨迹；对比时会将使用相同种子的运行进行配对。

paragraphs.en: The full recipe reaches higher success rates than both SPO baselines later in training for both model families (Figure 3 ). The gain over SPO + Muon supports combining the optimizer with the full set of recipe changes.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练后期，对于两种模型家族而言，完整配方比两种 SPO 基线方法都取得了更高的成功率（图 3）。 与 SPO + Muon 相比的改进表明，将优化器与完整的配方变更组合起来是有效的。

sents.en: The full recipe reaches higher success rates than both SPO baselines later in training for both model families (Figure 3 ).
sents.zh: 在训练后期，对于两种模型家族而言，完整配方比两种 SPO 基线方法都取得了更高的成功率（图 3）。

sents.en: The gain over SPO + Muon supports combining the optimizer with the full set of recipe changes.
sents.zh: 与 SPO + Muon 相比的改进表明，将优化器与完整的配方变更组合起来是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Across the recipe comparisons, training success continues to improve with the full recipe and declines in several Adam configurations (Figures 4 and 5 ). Without the length penalty, the relative performance of token-level and sequence-level averaging varies across seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 在各项配方对比中，使用完整配方的训练成功率持续提升，而在多种 Adam 配置下则出现下降（图 4 和图 5）。 在没有长度惩罚的情况下，基于词元级别和序列级别的平均方法在不同随机种子下的相对表现存在差异。

sents.en: Across the recipe comparisons, training success continues to improve with the full recipe and declines in several Adam configurations (Figures 4 and 5 ).
sents.zh: 在各项配方对比中，使用完整配方的训练成功率持续提升，而在多种 Adam 配置下则出现下降（图 4 和图 5）。

sents.en: Without the length penalty, the relative performance of token-level and sequence-level averaging varies across seeds.
sents.zh: 在没有长度惩罚的情况下，基于词元级别和序列级别的平均方法在不同随机种子下的相对表现存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Combining Muon with single-rollout asynchronous updates, importance correction, and auxiliary reward shaping yields higher training success than the SPO baselines in the evaluated runs from both model families.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估的运行中，将 Muon 与单次展开异步更新、重要性校正以及辅助奖励塑造相结合，相较于 SPO 基线方法，在两个模型家族中都取得了更高的训练成功率。
